# Event UI

> React 19 components for event pages, discovery, previews, forms, and animated backgrounds.

Package: `@event-ui/react` 0.1.0-alpha.0. Private alpha, UNLICENSED. Not published to npm. Source and asset review is unfinished.

Source access is required. No public repository is configured; obtain a checkout from the maintainer before installation.

## Start here

- [Integration guide and exact TypeScript API](https://ui.wtw.quest/llms-full.txt): install from a source checkout, examples, accessibility, CSS variables, and generated package declarations.
- [Export manifest](https://ui.wtw.quest/components.json): machine-readable imports, types, peer dependencies, CSS variables, and API fingerprint.
- [Component catalog](https://ui.wtw.quest/ui): interactive examples.
- [Full demo](https://ui.wtw.quest/demo): homepage, discovery, event pages, and previews.

Use the integration guide before editing a project. Read the manifest to confirm exact exports. Do not assume that an npm package or a public redistribution license exists.
